span.p: Replaces both Avro and Bincode strategies\nUses protobuf for all serialization

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; width: 200px;

span.p:
BENEFITS:
- Single implementation for all operations
- No duplicate logic between REST/gRPC
- Consistent error handling
- Easier to test

BENEFITS:
- No Avro conversion overhead
- Type safety with proto
- Simpler serialization
- Better performance
